78:2.text: (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism, the Qur’ân, which Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم brought and the Day of Resurrection)

78:3.text: About which they are in disagreement.

78:4.text: Nay, they will come to know!

78:5.text: Nay, again, they will come to know!

78:6.text: Have We not made the earth as a bed,

78:8.text: And We have created you in pairs
(male and female, tall and short, good and bad, etc.)

78:9.text: And We have made your sleep as a thing for rest.

78:10.text: And We have made the night as a covering

78:11.text: And We have made the day for livelihood.

78:12.text: And We have built above you seven strong

78:14.text: And We have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water.

78:15.text: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetations,

78:17.text: Verily, the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

78:18.text: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and you shall come forth in crowds

78:19.text: And the heaven shall be opened, and it will become as gates,

78:20.text: And the mountains shall be moved away from their places and they will be as if they were a mirage.

78:21.text: Truly, Hell is a place of ambush -

78:22.text: A dwelling place for the Tâghûn
(those who transgress the boundary limits set by Allâh like polytheists, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, hyprocrites, sinners, criminals)

78:23.text: They will abide therein for ages.

78:24.text: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink.

78:25.text: Except boiling water, and dirty wound discharges -

78:27.text: For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning.

78:28.text: (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, and that which Our Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم brought)

78:29.text: And all things We have recorded in a Book.

78:30.text: . No increase shall We give you, except in torment.
